scope: Explicit full A40 public entry: causal D64 extension, causal head grouping and immutable device-classification cache; default API and precision unchanged.

acceptance.directed: Existing rounded-equation gates and qualified pointwise cancellation/underflow checks; actual rounded forward O in delta.
acceptance.saved_statistics: Literal unscaled score maximum and shifted log2 normalizer, independent checks atol2e-4/rtol1e-6.
acceptance.precision: P and dS round once to input dtype; FP32 dots/delta/gradient accumulation; late dQ/dK scaling.

memcheck.scope: Actual public selected CUDA kernels and poisoned/changed replay; unchanged references on CPU per head.

racecheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

synccheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

initcheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

original_racecheck.completion: Incomplete; short BF16 S1024D64 case retained, long graph replay did not complete. Not a successful tool result.

tools.recovery: Same GPU/runtime bytes, same CPU numerical oracles; one S4096 F+B for BF16D64/G4 and FP16D128/G4, plus S1024 changed/poisoned graphs for BF16D64/G16 and FP16D128/G4. Previous full native G4/G16 tool qualification retained separately.

public-code-D64-S1024.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

public-code-D64-S4096.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

public-code-D128-S4096.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

fa2_code_reference: a40-causal-head-groups.json retains the exact loaded FA2 extension/ELF/PTX bindings; these three additional captures bind the actual public selected paths.

host_profile.scope: Warmed resident-tensor CPU profile outside performance timing; instrumented cProfile results excluded.

isolated_cache_control.scope: Same-process alternating graph replay and complete eager calls; forward retains gradients.
isolated_cache_control.event_scope: The eager CUDA-event interval includes launch gaps; graph replay is a separate device-path control.

limitations: Complete implementation comparisons to FA2/SDPA include their own arithmetic and host preparation.
Short eager timings can remain host-bound even when graph work improves.
Short CTA timeline probe exceeded its predefined5% perturbation limit; qualitative only and excluded from release timings.
Static instruction/resource observations are not runtime stall percentages.
